best_section.where: in the scrub about 40m east of the pin, away from the highway edge, near the tree clump

cannot_judge: Firmness of the dirt track and paddock surface after rain
Whether a gate or barrier has since been put across the access track
Street lighting or any lighting spill from the highway
How visible a van would be at night from passing headlights

drivers.seclusion: No houses anywhere in frame, but the field sits right alongside a divided highway and is overlooked from its bridge.
drivers.access_and_room: A worn dirt track leads in from near the bridge into a large open paddock with plenty of room to turn; no gate seen, but the surface looks rough and disturbed.
drivers.traffic: This is a fast, divided highway with trucks, not a quiet lane; noise and passing headlights would be constant.
drivers.convention: Not applicable — this is open paddock, not a kerb.

flags: Noise: busy highway and bridge run right alongside
Low-lying ground near a creek (~4m elevation) — flood-prone after heavy rain
Dumped rubble/debris near the access track
reasons: No houses, but highway runs right alongside
Rough track, dumped rubble near entrance
Open paddock, exposed to passing traffic
rubbish: Rubble and debris dumped near the access track; none seen at the best section itself.
summary: Open paddock beside a busy highway bridge — no houses, but noisy and exposed.
sun_shade: Mostly open to the sky; a few tree clumps to the north and east give partial afternoon shade.
